Server API

group FIRMWARE_UPDATE_SERVER_API

Functions for server-side firmware update operations.

Functions

bool fw_update_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Register the firmware update server.

Registers the firmware update server and associates a model data callback function to handle server events.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where server is registered.

  • model_data_cb -- [in] Callback function for model data processing. This callback handles server events.

Return values:

  • true -- If registration is successful.

  • false -- If registration fails due to invalid element. Recovery involves checking element index validity.

Returns:

Registration status.

bool fw_update_server_load(uint8_t *pfw_metadata, uint8_t metadata_len, uint8_t fw_image_index, uint8_t update_ttl, uint8_t update_timeout_base, uint8_t blob_id[8])

Load the firmware update server with update information.

Loads the firmware update server with necessary update information and parameters.

Parameters:

  • pfw_metadata -- [in] Pointer to firmware metadata. Must be a valid memory address.

  • metadata_len -- [in] Length of firmware metadata. Maximum length is 255.

  • fw_image_index -- [in] Firmware image index. Must be a valid index for the image.

  • update_ttl -- [in] Time-to-live for update. Range is 0-255.

  • update_timeout_base -- [in] Base timeout for update. Base has range depending on network conditions.

  • blob_id -- [in] BLOB identifier for update process. 8-byte identifier used uniquely in the update.

Return values:

  • true -- If load is successful.

  • false -- If load fails due to invalid parameters. Ensure all parameters are within valid ranges.

Returns:

Load status.

bool fw_update_server_add_info(fw_id_t *pfw_id, uint8_t fw_id_len, uint8_t *pupdate_uri, uint8_t update_uri_len)

Add firmware update information to the server.

Adds new firmware update information including firmware ID and update URI to the server's context.

Parameters:

  • pfw_id -- [in] Pointer to firmware ID. Must be a valid memory address.

  • fw_id_len -- [in] Length of firmware ID. Maximum length is 255.

  • pupdate_uri -- [in] Pointer to update URI. Must be a valid URI format.

  • update_uri_len -- [in] Length of update URI. Maximum length is 255.

Return values:

  • true -- If addition is successful.

  • false -- If addition fails due to memory constraints. Ensure sufficient memory is available.

Returns:

Add status.

void fw_update_server_set_verify_result(bool success)

Set the firmware verification result on the server.

Sets the verification result for the firmware update process on the server.

Parameters:

success -- [in] TRUE if verification succeeded, which proceeds the update process. FALSE if verification failed, halts the update process.

void fw_update_server_clear(void)

Clear the firmware update server context.

Clears all firmware update-related data from the server context.

int32_t fw_update_handle_blob_server_data(const mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, uint32_t type, void *pargs)

Handle BLOB server data for firmware update.

Processes the BLOB data received during the firmware update process on the server side.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to BLOB transfer server model. Must not be NULL.

  • type -- [in] Data callback message type. Must be a valid callback type.

  • pargs -- [in] Pointer to data callback value. May be NULL if not required.

Return values:

Returns -- Status or result code from data handling. Ensure proper handling of returned value.

Returns:

Handling result.

bool fw_update_client_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Register the firmware update client.

Registers the firmware update client with a callback function to handle events.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where client is registered.

  • model_data_cb -- [in] Callback function for client model data processing. This handles client-side events.

Return values:

  • true -- If registration is successful.

  • false -- If registration fails. Check model data callback function and element index.

Returns:

Registration status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_update_info_get(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t first_index, uint8_t entries_limit)

Get firmware update information.

Sends a request to retrieve firmware update information from a remote server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Remote address to request update info. Must be a valid network address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for request. Must match the server's key index.

  • first_index -- [in] First index in firmware info list. Starting index for retrieval.

  • entries_limit -- [in] Maximum number of info entries to retrieve. Must not exceed max capacity.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If request is successful.

  • Others -- If request fails due to network issues. Consider retrying the request.

Returns:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_update_fw_metadata_check(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t update_fw_image_idx, uint8_t *pfw_metadata, uint8_t metadata_len)

Check firmware metadata on client side.

Requests a metadata check on a specified firmware image from a remote server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Remote address to check metadata. Must be a valid server address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for check. Ensure correct key index is used.

  • update_fw_image_idx -- [in] Firmware image index for update. Must be correct index for the image.

  • pfw_metadata -- [in] Pointer to firmware metadata. Metadata to be verified.

  • metadata_len -- [in] Length of firmware metadata. Maximum length is dependent on server capabilities.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If check is successful.

  • Others -- If check fails due to network issues. Retry or check connectivity.

Returns:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_update_get(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Get firmware update status.

Queries the current status of a firmware update process from a server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Remote address for status request. Must be a valid address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for request. Ensure app key is valid and correct.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If status retrieval is successful.

  • Others -- If retrieval fails due to network issues. Retry or verify server status.

Returns:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_update_start(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t update_ttl, uint16_t update_timeout_base, uint8_t blob_id[8], uint8_t update_fw_image_idx, uint8_t *pfw_metadata, uint8_t metadata_len)

Start the firmware update process on client side.

Initiates a firmware update process by sending the start command and required parameters to a server.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Remote address to start update. Must be a valid server address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for update. Ensure the correct key index is in use.

  • update_ttl -- [in] Time-to-live for update messages. Must be set according to network requirements.

  • update_timeout_base -- [in] Base timeout for update process. Define according to network conditions.

  • blob_id -- [in] BLOB identifier for update. Must be unique for each update process.

  • update_fw_image_idx -- [in] Firmware image index for update. Specify the correct image index.

  • pfw_metadata -- [in] Pointer to firmware metadata. Ensure correct metadata is supplied.

  • metadata_len -- [in] Length of firmware metadata. Maximum length is 255.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If update start is successful.

  • Others -- If update fails due to network issues. Check parameters and retry if necessary.

Returns:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_update_cancel(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Cancel the firmware update process on client side.

Sends a cancel command to abort an ongoing firmware update process.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Remote address to cancel update. Must correspond to the server handling the update.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for cancellation. Ensure it aligns with the server key index.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If cancel is successful.

  • Others -- If cancel fails due to network issues. Verify server response and retry if possible.

Returns:

Send status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t fw_update_apply(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Apply firmware update on client side.

Sends an apply command to execute and finalize a firmware update.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] Remote address to apply update. Must match the intended server address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] App key index used for apply process. Ensure it matches the server's configuration.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- If apply is successful.

  • Others -- If apply fails due to network issues. Confirm server state and retry.

Returns:

Send status.
